```sql
with fx as (
    select rate_date, aud_nzd_rate
    from staging.stg_erp__fx_rates
),
materials as (
    select sku, standard_cost_nzd
    from staging.stg_erp__materials m
    left join reference.material_groups mg on m.material_group = mg.material_group
    where mg.product_category = 'Bakeware'
),
pos_bakeware as (
    select 
        l.line_total as net_rev,
        l.quantity * m.standard_cost_nzd as total_cost,
        case when m.standard_cost_nzd is not null then l.line_total else 0 end as costed_rev
    from staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines l
    inner join materials m on l.sku = m.sku
    inner join staging.stg_erp__stores s on l.store_id = s.store_id
    where l.txn_date >= '2025-04-01' and l.txn_date <= '2026-03-31'
      and l.is_valid = true
      and l.txn_type = 'SALE'
      and s.country = 'New Zealand'
),
ecom_bakeware as (
    select 
        l.line_total as net_rev,
        l.quantity * m.standard_cost_nzd as total_cost,
        case when m.standard_cost_nzd is not null then l.line_total else 0 end as costed_rev
    from staging.stg_ecom__order_lines l
    inner join staging.stg_ecom__orders o on l.order_id = o.order_id
    inner join materials m on l.sku = m.sku
    where o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' and o.order_date <= '2026-03-31'
      and o.order_status != 'Cancelled'
      and o.region_code in ('NZ', 'AUS')
),
erp_bakeware as (
    select 
        case when l.currency = 'AUD' then l.net_value * coalesce(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0) else l.net_value end as net_rev,
        l.quantity * m.standard_cost_nzd as total_cost,
        case when m.standard_cost_nzd is not null then 
            case when l.currency = 'AUD' then l.net_value * coalesce(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0) else l.net_value end
        else 0 end as costed_rev
    from staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines l
    inner join staging.stg_erp__customers c on l.customer_id = c.customer_id
    inner join materials m on l.material_id = m.sku
    left join fx f on l.order_date = f.rate_date
    where l.order_date >= '2025-04-01' and l.order_date <= '2026-03-31'
      and c.country in ('New Zealand', 'Australia')
),
combined as (
    select net_rev, total_cost, costed_rev from pos_bakeware
    union all
    select net_rev, total_cost, costed_rev from ecom_bakeware
    union all
    select net_rev, total_cost, costed_rev from erp_bakeware
)
select 
    (sum(net_rev) - sum(total_cost)) / nullif(sum(costed_rev), 0) as answer
from combined;
```
